# Litematica-GPT

This repository combines a Java Litematica mod with a Python ML pipeline for Gemma 4.

## Core Resources
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Main agent instructions and project overview.
- [ml_workspace/](ml_workspace/AGENTS.md): The Machine Learning workspace.
- [src/](src/): Java source for the Litematica mod.

## ML Pipeline
- [scripts/](ml_workspace/scripts/AGENTS.md): Data prep, training, and evaluation scripts.
- [data/](ml_workspace/data/AGENTS.md): Raw and processed datasets.
- [models/](ml_workspace/models_and_adapters/AGENTS.md): LoRA adapters and model artifacts.
